rationale: The shed camera shows RSSI -87 dBm (below the -80 dBm threshold), with 9 heartbeat losses in 24h and intermittent status, while all other devices are online. Firmware is compatible (v3 protocol supported) and battery is healthy at 64%, ruling out firmware or battery causes. This matches the documented weak-signal symptom pattern (intermittent disconnects, choppy live view) and is resolvable at frontline by relocating the device or installing an RP-1 repeater.

repair_steps: Advise customer to move the shed camera closer to the base station or remove obstacles (e.g., metal objects, thick walls) between them.
If relocation is not possible, recommend installing an RP-1 repeater between the base station and the shed camera.
After adjustment, verify RSSI improves to above -80 dBm (ideally above -70 dBm) and monitor for 24 hours to ensure no further disconnections.
output.customer_reply: Thank you for your patience. Our diagnostics show the shed camera is experiencing a weak wireless signal, not a hardware fault. To resolve this, please try moving the camera closer to the base station or removing obstacles. If that's not possible, we recommend installing an RP-1 repeater to boost the signal. Once adjusted, the camera should work reliably. We're here to help if you need further assistance.

results.text: Peripherals talk to the base station over a sub-GHz proprietary radio. Signal strength (RSSI) is shown in Device Settings > Device Info. Above -70 dBm is good, -70 to -80 dBm is acceptable, below -80 dBm causes intermittent disconnections, delayed notifications and choppy live view. Concrete walls, metal doors and fridges strongly attenuate the signal. Fix: move the device or base station, or install the official RP-1 repeater.
Customer reported a CAM-S1 in a detached garage going offline several times a day. RSSI was -86 dBm; all other devices normal. Installing an RP-1 repeater solved it. Resolved at frontline.

Base station online, live view works on local network, but no event notifications; E-503 every few minutes. Router restart and DNS reset did not help. Escalated; expired device certificate on backend. Escalated correctly.

complaint: The camera on the garden shed is clearly defective. It keeps freezing and going offline and the picture is choppy. It's only four months old and still under warranty, so I'd like a replacement unit sent out please. I've already restarted it a few times and it makes no difference.
